Hi all — quick clarification from the security engineering side: our typical structure for a combined session is 75–90 minutes:

- 30–40 minutes: SOC 2 controls review (evidence handoff + Q&A)
- 20–25 minutes: DPA contract clarifications (data flows, retention, encryption keys)
- 20–25 minutes: Pen-test scoping (scope boundaries, target systems, vendor constraints)

We can be intentional about timeboxing the pen-test scoping portion. If the CISO prefers, she can join only for the controls + DPA portion (~55–65 minutes) and then leave for the vendor scoping. We'll mark the agenda accordingly and highlight the handoff point.

I'll put placeholder calendar invites for Thu 04 Jun 9:00pm ET (primary) and Tue 02 Jun 8:30pm ET (fallback) — will send final invite once Finovate confirms.
